service.basis: GUGiK's collective WFS gathers parcel and building data from the county EGiB WFS services listed in the Register of Spatial Data Sets and Services (EZiUDP, https://integracja.gugik.gov.pl/eziudp/).
service.cors: No Access-Control-Allow-Origin header (2026-10-12): browsers reach it through the production provider relay.

schema.axisOrder: northing-easting (EPSG::2180 URN); a raw sample in TERYT county 2805 projects into Ełk county only in this order
schema.identity: ID_DZIALKI equals ULDK's TERYT parcel ID for the same parcel (e.g. Szczecin 326201_1.1024.21/2)

matchCountSemantics: A data page states numberMatched when it holds the whole matched set (sorted or not); a larger set, and an empty ID query, report numberMatched="unknown". The adapter accepts one page as complete only when numberMatched equals numberReturned and the members; otherwise it runs hits, pages and hits, reusing the first page.
latency: About 2.5-3.5 s per request from a German server (median 2.7 s over 102 requests, one 15 s timeout).
areaProbeNote: Each non-Szczecin probe was a 0.002 x 0.003 degree box at the city point; every response held complete polygons (polygon count equal to numberMatched).
reachability: From one consumer network mapy.geoportal.gov.pl did not resolve and GUGiK addresses did not answer (as for ULDK); the production relay and another server reached it.
